get.description: Returns the total sends count, bounce rate, and complaint rate for the specified period.
Returns daily send counts (total, bounced, complained, accepted, queued) for the last 30 days.
Returns all API keys of the project. The raw key is not returned; only its metadata is.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the project. The raw key is returned only once and must be stored securely.

200.description: Returns the created API key. The `key` property is the raw key, which is only returned once.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an API key. Requests made with the deleted key will be rejected immediately.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the name, scopes, enabled status, or allowed IPs of an API key.

200.description: Returns the updated API key object.

get.description: Returns all domains registered for the project.

post.description: Registers a new domain for the project. Generates DKIM keys by default unless a custom private key is provided.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a domain from the project.

200.description: Returns an empty response on success.

post.description: Verifies the DKIM DNS records of a pending domain and updates its status.

get.summary: Get a domain by ID or name
get.description: Returns a single domain identified by its ID or domain name.
Returns the project that the current API key or session belongs to.

post.description: Creates a new project in the current organization and adds the authenticated user to it.

200.description: Returns the project-user object of the creator in the new project.

patch.description: Updates the current project. Only the project name can be changed.

get.description: Returns all users that have access to the project.

post.summary: Add a user to the project
post.description: Adds an existing user to the project with the given scopes.

delete.summary: Remove all users from the project
delete.description: Removes all project users except the owner.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

delete.summary: Remove a user from the project
delete.description: Removes a single user from the project.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of emails sent from the project.

post.description: Sends an email from the project. Supports To, Cc, Bcc, attachments, and custom headers.

200.description: Returns the created send ID and Message-ID.

get.description: Returns a single send including its recipients, attempts, and feedback.

post.description: Retries sending to failed recipients of a send. Already queued sends are rescheduled to now.

200.description: Returns the number of retried recipients and the updated send object.

get.description: Returns a single send by its public UUID.
Returns the stored content (HTML, text, headers, and raw) of a send by its UUID.
Returns suppressed email addresses for the project.

delete.description: Removes an email address from the project suppressions list.

200.description: Returns an empty object on success.

get.description: Returns all webhooks configured for the project, including their secrets.

post.description: Creates a new webhook for the project and returns its signing secret.

200.description: Returns the created webhook object with its secret.
Returns an empty object on success.

patch.description: Updates the URL, description, or events of a webhook.

200.description: Returns the updated webhook object. The secret is not returned.

get.description: Returns delivery attempts for webhooks of the project.
